brief:
Israeli forces killed a Palestinian man during a pre-dawn raid on his home in Jenin on Friday, IMEMC News reported. The operation was part of a broader security operation by occupation forces in the northern West Bank city.

In a separate incursion hours later, Israeli troops shot a 14-year-old child with live ammunition during an invasion of Zababdah, a town located southeast of Jenin. The shooting of the teenager marked the second reported casualty from the day's military operations in the region.
dek: Before dawn on Friday, Israeli forces killed a Palestinian man after storming his home in the northern West Bank city of Jenin. Occupation forces also shot a 14-year-old child with live ammunition after invading the town of Zababdah, southeast of the city.…
title: Israeli forces kill man in Jenin, wound teenager in nearby Zababdah
